text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v2.3.0 -> 3% traffic (us-west). change window open. canary id: canary-842. kicked off 12:30 UTC.

maria: watching dashboards — p95 on /generate jumped ~180ms right after shift :thinking_face:

leo: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/team/infra/d/xyz123/canary?panelId=7 (shows p50/p95/drift)

sre_oncall: looking at traces now, tokenization service queues growing, sampling traces...

chris: quick grep from model-serve logs shows repeated: `ERROR upstream read timeout` and a handful of 502s from model backend

maria: hmm, that aligns with what prod-proxy is showing. i recommend pausing before it affects more users

deploy-bot: Staged rollout paused (manual). traffic frozen at 3%. marking canary-842 as paused.

ops: running rollback to v2.2.9 for model-serve now — command: `deploy rollback --service model-serve --to v2.2.9 --canary canary-842`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for model-serve -> v2.2.9. will post status updates when complete.

leo: please also pin routing to v2.2.9 for us-west until we verify fix :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: pin applied to us-west (routing-pin:v2.2.9). watching error/success rates.

maria: creating an incident/ops ticket and adding release notes stub — follow-up in #incidents. tagging @oncall for postmortem.

chris: I'll start a quick binary diff and check the quantization/kernel changes in v2.3.0 that could cause timeouts

maria: thanks. once rollback fully completes we can schedule a blameless postmortem and decide next roll strategy. moving discussion to incidents for root-cause.
